architecture.pattern: connector registry plus a global winner scheduler, dynamic factory discovery, adaptive sizing, and code-hash-pinned V4 settlement
architecture.isolation_boundaries: scanner and bridge discovery remain walletless; only a manifest-verified executor with a typed relay protocol may sign or submit, and V4 settlement accepts only the pinned PoolManager during an Aave callback
execution_flow: validate environment configuration and risk policy
index finalized protocol events and validate live scanner candidates without a wallet
transform typed liquidation candidates, dynamic factory candidates, and head-pinned DEX quote evidence into executor-ready opportunities
derive adaptive sizes and simulate every permitted allocation from both sources under one bounded concurrency limit
select exactly one globally highest-net allowed plan with stable tie-breaking
repeat exact preflight and submit only through the explicitly verified relay protocol
value the receipt conservatively or persist the autonomous-execution halt

inputs.config: SkillConfig, ScannerConfig, DynamicSolverConfig, and secret-free bridge policy

test_criteria: configuration defaults and validation are covered
every liquidation and DEX plan is simulated before global selection
adaptive live-bound sizes are quoted before selection and no fixed USD tier is selected
configured V2/V3 factories produce allowlisted, non-broadcastable pool candidates
an invalid split allocation cannot broadcast
the final executor adapter preflights immediately before send
scan mode rejects execution flags and never constructs a wallet client
scan output distinguishes Balancer callback loans from Uniswap v4 unlock delta settlement
dynamic close-factor, capability, quote-freshness, fixed-point DEX valuation, and memory-redaction behavior are covered
a local pinned Arbitrum fork proves executor bytecode, selectors, exact simulation, and no upstream transaction send
a fake relay proves configured submission behavior and no public-RPC fallback
V4 unlock callbacks settle only the exact flash-route amount and reject unauthenticated direct invocation
